boundary: offline descriptor and geometric correspondence pilot, not autonomous recognition
geometricModel: Kornia 0.8.1 DISK depth plus LightGlue disk
referencePolicy: Existing user-authorized cached Commons clips only. Three frames from source A at fractions 0.15, 0.5, 0.85. Independent source B queries at 0.2,0.8; no source B reference frames. Remaining clips use temporal repeat controls, never generalization proof.
geographyPolicy: Compare all gallery versus source-catalog country filter where explicit; coarse location supplied as an experimental prior, never inferred from correct identity. Unknown country uses full gallery. La Jolla labels are locality-only because Commons location/category conflict prevents verified exact venue status.
scoring: Recall@1/3/5 by catalog source locality group, source-level counts. Same-video versus independent clips reported separately. No query labels influence descriptor model, similarity, or matching.
geometricPolicy: Top three descriptor shortlist entries only; 512 DISK features; RANSAC homography with 4px reprojection error; >=8 inliers and >=0.2 ratio means visual overlap support, never venue proof. Include mismatched place comparisons and repeated water scenes.
stop: No tuning from output. If data rights/model installation/coverage fail, record limitation. No paid provider calls, no new server, no runtime activation or permanent Google imagery corpus.
